title: Ānanda, for whomever you have compassion, and those who you think should listen to you, friends, companions, relatives, or blood relations — for them, Ānanda,…
content: Ānanda, for whomever you have compassion, and those who you think should listen to you, friends, companions, relatives, or blood relations — for them, Ānanda, you should encourage, instruct, and establish in three things. What three? Encourage, instruct, and establish in unwavering confidence in the Buddha: 'He is the Blessed One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, the Well-Gone, the Knower of the world, the Unsurpassed Trainer of persons, the Teacher of devas and humans, the Buddha, the Blessed One.' Encourage, instruct, and establish in unwavering confidence in the Dhamma: 'The Dhamma is well taught by the Blessed One, visible here and now, timeless, inviting inspection, leading onward, to be experienced by the wise for themselves.' Encourage, instruct, and establish in unwavering confidence in the Saṅgha: 'The Saṅgha of the Blessed One's disciples is practicing the good way, the straight way, the true way, the proper way; that is, the four pairs of persons, the eight individuals. This Saṅgha of the Blessed One's disciples is worthy of gifts, worthy of hospitality, worthy of offerings, worthy of reverential salutation, the unsurpassed field of merit for the world.' Ānanda, even if the four great elements — earth, water, fire, air — were to change, a noble disciple who possesses unwavering confidence in the Buddha does not change. Here, change is this: That noble disciple, Ānanda, who possesses unwavering confidence in the Buddha, would be reborn in hell, the animal realm, or the ghost realm — this is impossible.

title: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, when walking for alms in the village or town, receives coarse or fine food as much as he wishes. He thinks:…
content: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, when walking for alms in the village or town, receives coarse or fine food as much as he wishes. He thinks: 'I walked for alms in the village or town and received coarse or fine food as much as I wished. My body has strength and can bear it. Let me arouse energy... to realize the unrealized.' He arouses energy... unrealized. Bhikkhus, this is the sixth ground for diligence.

title: Māra: You are young and beautiful, I am young and youthful. With a five-piece orchestra, Enjoy yourself, Khemā." Elder Nun Khemā: With this foul body,…
content:
Māra:
You are young and beautiful,
I am young and youthful.
With a five-piece orchestra,
Enjoy yourself, Khemā."

Elder Nun Khemā:

With this foul body,
Diseased and frail,
I am disgusted and reject it.
Sensual desire is uprooted.

Sensual desires are like swords and spears,
The aggregates are like a chopping block.
What you call sensual pleasure
I have now abandoned.

Everywhere, joy is destroyed,
The mass of delusion is shattered.
Know thus, Evil One!
You are defeated, O Death.

You worship the morning star!
You worship fire in the deep forest!
Not knowing the truth,
Fools think it pure.

But I bow down
To the Awakened One, the Supreme Person.
Freed from all suffering,
I follow the Teacher's instruction.

title: Bhikkhus, when this Noble Truth of Suffering is realized and understood; when this Noble Truth of the Origin of Suffering is realized and understood; when…
content:
Bhikkhus, when this Noble Truth of Suffering is realized and understood; when this Noble Truth of the Origin of Suffering is realized and understood; when this Noble Truth of the Cessation of Suffering is realized and understood; when this Noble Truth of the Path leading to the Cessation of Suffering is realized and understood, then craving for existence is destroyed, the conduit to a new life is cut off, now there is no further becoming.
The Blessed One spoke thus. The Well-Gone added further:
'Because the Four Noble Truths were not seen as they are, there was long wandering through many births. When these truths are recognized, the cause of another existence is destroyed; when the root of suffering is cut, there will be no further existence.'

title: - Truly, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu who delights in company, takes pleasure in company, is devoted to delight in company, delights in a group, takes…
content: - Truly, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu who delights in company, takes pleasure in company, is devoted to delight in company, delights in a group, takes pleasure in a group, is devoted to delight in a group — that he will rejoice in dwelling alone, in seclusion — this is impossible. Not rejoicing in dwelling alone, in seclusion, he will grasp the sign of the mind — this is impossible. Not grasping the sign of the mind, he will fulfill right view — this is impossible. Not fulfilling right view, he will fulfill right concentration — this is impossible. Not fulfilling right concentration, he will abandon the fetters — this is impossible. Not abandoning the fetters, he will realize Nibbāna — this is impossible.

title: This city is built of bones, Plastered with flesh and blood, Here dwell old age and death, Conceit and deceit are stored.
content:
This city is built of bones,
Plastered with flesh and blood,
Here dwell old age and death,
Conceit and deceit are stored.

title: Bhikkhus, if while examining the danger in those thoughts, evil, unwholesome thoughts connected with desire, ill-will, and delusion still arise in that bhikkhu, then that…
content: Bhikkhus, if while examining the danger in those thoughts, evil, unwholesome thoughts connected with desire, ill-will, and delusion still arise in that bhikkhu, then that bhikkhu should not attend to or give attention to those thoughts. By not attending to or giving attention to those thoughts, those evil, unwholesome thoughts connected with desire, ill-will, and delusion are abandoned and subside. Through their abandonment, his mind becomes inwardly steady, settled, unified, and concentrated. Bhikkhus, just as a person with eyes, not wishing to see forms within their range, would close their eyes or look away; so too, bhikkhus, if that bhikkhu does not attend to or give attention to those thoughts ... his mind becomes inwardly steady, settled, unified, and concentrated.

title: He has perfect confidence in the virtue that is dear to the noble ones, complete and unbroken, unblemished, unspotted, untarnished, leading to liberation, praised by…
content: He has perfect confidence in the virtue that is dear to the noble ones, complete and unbroken, unblemished, unspotted, untarnished, leading to liberation, praised by the wise, not influenced by future lives, conducive to concentration.

title: The disciples of Gotama Are always awake, Whether by day or by night, They constantly recollect the body. The disciples of Gotama Are always awake,…
content:
The disciples of Gotama
Are always awake,
Whether by day or by night,
They constantly recollect the body.

The disciples of Gotama
Are always awake,
Whether by day or by night,
Their mind delights in non-harming.

The disciples of Gotama
Are always awake,
Whether by day or by night,
Their mind delights in meditation.

title: Excellent, Venerable Gotama! Excellent, Venerable Gotama! Just as one sets upright what was overturned, or reveals what was hidden, or shows the way to one…
content: Excellent, Venerable Gotama! Excellent, Venerable Gotama! Just as one sets upright what was overturned, or reveals what was hidden, or shows the way to one who is lost, or holds up a lamp in the darkness so that those with eyes can see forms, so too, the Dhamma has been explained in many ways by Venerable Gotama. I go for refuge to Venerable Gotama, to the Dhamma, and to the Saṅgha. May Venerable Gotama accept me as a lay follower, from today until the end of my life, I take refuge.
